name: swimming crawl style
description: A prone floor drill that imitates the alternating arm strokes of front-crawl swimming. It warms the shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Lie face down with your legs extended and your arms reaching forward.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor without straining your lower back.
Sweep one arm down and back as the other reaches forward, then alternate in a smooth front-crawl rhythm.
Let your torso rotate slightly with each stroke and breathe steadily for the set time.
